title: Wren and the House
author: Theo Voss
blurb: Sebastian Crane, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
